description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Esper Terra that isn't legendary. This will cause it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter as it will be a Saga.
Spark Double's first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
The Spark Double token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Spark Doubler trigger, creating a token copy of Spark Double with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Terra, Magical Adept // Esper Terra
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Esper Terra
